name: The Chalice of the Forsaken
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Sister Mairead Solène
preparation: shake all ingredients with ice for 10 to 15 seconds, then strain into a double old-fashioned glass over fresh ice
garnish: a maraschino cherry, lime wedge, and fresh mint

name: The Gift of the Grove
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Aina of Nalu‘ea
preparation: shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a tall old-fashioned glass filled with crushed ice
garnish: a lime wedge and fresh cranberries

name: A Lover's Return
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Elira, the Widow of the Spring Tide
preparation: shake with ice and strain into a glass over crushed ice

name: The Last Man
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Captain Datura, the Forsaken Commander
preparation: shake well with one cup of crushed ice

name: The Still Path
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Rei Takamura, the Rusted Blade

ingredients.name: Smuggler's Cove Mai Tai rich simple syrup

preparation: shake with 12 ounces of pebble ice and strain into a rocks glass over crushed ice
garnish: a spent lime shell and mint sprig

name: The Moment's Embrace
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Amara the Seer, Who Looked Away
preparation: combine everything except the sparkling wine in a shaker and chill, pour into a Collins glass with ice, top with sparkling wine, and stir gently

name: The Kraken's Curse
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Captain Tiber Malvayne, the Bound Steward of the Deep
preparation: flash-blend with ice for 5 seconds, pour into a glass, and top with pebble ice

name: The Bitter Reprieve
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Lord Marik, the Butcher King
preparation: shake everything except the dark rum and bitters, strain over ice, then float the dark rum and bitters

name: The Maelstrom's Fury
source: Krakens_Curse_Grimoire.pdf, The Pact of Seraphine of the Drowned Tongue
preparation: shake all ingredients and strain into a glass with crushed ice
